findings.location: Note T3/N1.3 and runner family_d D2; all historical summaries
findings.finding: Comparator product prohibition is false in the representation actually compared. Its partial Fourier inverse is q(k)^|s|/sqrt((2+E_2(k))²-4); a mixed derivative in full Fourier space cannot rule this out or all rotated frames.
findings.repair: Withdraw broad negative and preserve its failed argument. Keep only the narrow fixed-coordinate full-Fourier nonseparability result if needed, or state the corrected mixed-representation kernel with proof. Do not infer any physical-gravity exclusion.

findings.location: Note T2 and plain-language interpretation; runner C1-C2
findings.finding: The order-six substitutions form a subgroup: inversion yields 12 symmetries of u. Coordinate eigenvalue anisotropy is not physical in-plane anisotropy: M=G^-1/3 in the oblique plane basis. The cone axis is normal to the plane.
findings.repair: Call order six a subgroup, distinguish u symmetry from phi phase symmetry, remove false physical anisotropy, and retain accurate coordinate quadratic form.

findings.location: Note T1 proof and declared modes; runner B1-B2/docstring
findings.finding: Complex covariance convention is omitted and recurrence uses phi whereas stated Hermitian lag formula then requires conjugate(phi). Cosine tests are blind to this sign; docstring itself uses both signs.
findings.repair: Declare negative-exponent DFT, multiplier psi=(1+e^-ik1+e^-ik2)/3 and E[X_t conjugate(X_t+s)]=conjugate(psi)^s V_t. Add complex phase-sensitive control. Clarify stationary nonzero-mode projection, zero mode, L=1, u=0 and s=0 boundaries.

findings.location: Note nonlinear result/Executed/N7, historical checker and output files
findings.finding: Finite simulation logs do not establish c(beta)->1, exact phases, common normalization, stationarity or all-mode few-percent agreement. Raw beta12 mode(2,2) lag64 is .907/.983 (7.73% relative error); phase differences are visible. Shells use [0,2pi) coordinate representatives. Rotating-frame comparison changes L and reports no errors.
findings.repair: Preserve every control and raw output as finite historical observation; explicitly defer nonlinear asymptotics/calibration and revise quoted accuracy. No new simulation needed.
